CIRCULAR

HO/38/11/(5)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/5130/2026 February 17, 2026

To,

All Recognized Stock Exchanges

All Clearing corporations

Madam / Sir,

Sub: Forms for registration of stock brokers and clearing members

Section 1: Under Schedule I of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Stock Brokers)

Regulations, 1992 (repealed), the application forms for registration of stock broker and clearing member along with certificate of registration were specified.

Section 2: SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 2026 provides that such form shall be specified by Board or recognised stock exchange. In view of the same, the application forms and certificate of registration have been specified under Annexure

Section 3: The provisions of this circular shall come into force, retrospectively, from the date of notification of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Stock brokers)

Regulations, 2026 i.e. January 07, 2026.

Section 4: The Stock Exchanges/Clearing Corporations are directed to:

4.1. bring the provisions of this circular to the notice of their members / participants and also disseminate the same on their websites;

4.2. make necessary amendments to the relevant Bye-laws, Rules and Regulations for the implementation of the above decision;

Page 1 of 7

Section 5: This circular is issued in exercise of powers conferred under Section 11(1) of

Regulation 51 of Securities Contracts (Regulation) (Stock Exchanges and Clearing

Corporations) Regulations, 2018 to protect the interests of investors in securities and to promote the development of, and to regulate the securities markets.

Section 6: This circular is available on SEBI website at www.sebi.gov.in under the category: ‘Legal → Circulars’

Yours faithfully,

Aradhana Verma

General Manager

Tel. No: 022 26449633 aradhanad@sebi.gov.in
